question: Did the sigma commit (b4e438a) change the DEPTH the blend produces?
why: blend.py sits on the depth path. Every v7 depth number in the READMEs was measured BEFORE b4e438a. If depth moved, those numbers are stale and the blend A/B would be scoring a silently-changed blend.
method: Pre-sigma blend_depth extracted from ab25f0d and the current one called on byte-identical real inputs (deployed engines, real logged frames, center-island anchor split). Bitwise comparison, not allclose.
source: ros2_ws/data/real (1234 frames, every 20th taken so the sample spans the whole log)
conclusion: All v7 depth numbers stand unchanged. The sigma work is additive: it raises var and leaves depth untouched.
code_evidence: git diff ab25f0d b4e438a on blend.py touches the depth path only by appending a third return element behind a default-False kwarg; pipeline.py assigns metric identically and only adds a term to var. gpu_ops.py gains one new function and modifies none.
